'''Regina Y. Liu''' is an American [[statistician]]. She is a distinguished professor of statistics and chair of the Department of Statistics and Biostatistics at [[Rutgers University]].{{r|rfac}} Her research concerns [[robust statistics]] and [[nonparametric statistics]], including the first formulation of [[simplicial depth]].{{ran|PNAS}}{{ran|AS90}}

Liu earned her Ph.D. in statistics from Columbia University in 1983, under the supervision of John Raphael Van Ryzin,{{r|mgp}} and joined the Rutgers faculty at that time. She became a distinguished professor at Rutgers in 2001,{{r|cv}}
and department chair in 2005.{{r|sin}}

Liu became a [[Fellow of the American Statistical Association]] in 2005.{{r|fasa}} She is also a fellow of the [[Institute of Mathematical Statistics]].{{r|cv}}
